summary: The private `inputAlmostComplex` and its lemmas copy the existing manifold `pairOfPantsAlmostComplex` construction and proofs only because the public definition takes a `ThricePuncturedSphere` rather than a point of `ℂ`; the rest of the PR reuses existing API.
